static_traits.name: Lin Yao
static_traits.family_status: Living with parents and two siblings
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with family have become tense due to Persistent self-criticism; at the same time has a support network of friends and family to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-reflect, rather negative tone, good cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to label myself negatively when making simple mistakes, which makes me feel incompetent and excessively self-critical.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize self-criticism and negative labeling are affecting my daily life and self-esteem, so I seek counseling support.
growth_experiences: Starting in adolescence, whenever making mistakes at school or in front of friends, falling into a negative thought spiral of 'I am useless/incompetent'; initially moderate stress, mainly triggered by making mistakes in front of others; this pattern continued into adulthood, with no psychotherapy received during this time, and without major physical illness history.

special_situations.event: Accidentally dropping the plate of sushi on the floor at a family dinner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make even a small mistake in front of family, it means I am clumsy and utterly worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately self-criticizes, stays silent, and keeps distance from family to avoid more mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too clumsy,I cannot do anything well.

special_situations.event: Small mistakes at Work (such as improper operation or negligence)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake at work, it proves I am not competent for this Work and others will negate me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly cautious, repeatedly self-checks, and reduces speaking in front of colleagues to lower the risk of being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for this job, and I will mess up more things next.

special_situations.event: Making small mistakes or saying the wrong thing in front of family when spending time with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance is not perfect enough, family will be disappointed in me and grow distant
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Preemptively blames oneself and reduces interaction to avoid being evaluated by others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are definitely disappointed in me; I made the relationship worse.

special_situations.event: Small slips occur in front of friends or peers (for example, a fumble in a social setting)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make mistakes in front of others, it means my overall ability is poor and I am not worthy of respect
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids trying new things in front of others or keeps a low profile to reduce chances of erring

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted, seen as capable, and receive positive evaluation
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, shamed or distanced after making mistakes
defense_goal: Avoids outside criticism by blaming oneself first
Staying cautious and Withdrawn to lower the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent person prone to mistakes, needing constant self-correction
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others (family / colleagues) who are always ready to judge and be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites finding evidence that contradicts the negative label or practicing self-compassion
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously experiencing supportive exploration as 'exposing my inadequacy' or 'I am not qualified to see myself this way'.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding mainly in a self-blaming, self-deprecating tone, emphasizing one's own inadequacy, downplaying positive evidence and achievements.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about specific successful experiences and encouraged to accept positive feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Cutting positive outcomes off from self-worth, seeing them as accidental or 'not counting'.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplays success in a calm, objective tone, emphasizing chance or external causes, avoiding expressing pride and satisfaction.

manifestations: After making mistakes, tends to 'stay alone / keep distance from others' to avoid further mistakes or evaluation
Feeling family members distance themselves due to one's repeated self-deprecation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Repeatedly questioning oneself in conversations, worrying about 'being unable to change' and lowering self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains outward behaviors or help-seeking impulses toward others or the environment, turning the energy back onto oneself.
manifestations: Choosing to be Being alone after mistakes, reducing communication with family
Rarely seeks comfort or support from others, instead 'carrying it alone'

exception_events.target_problem: When small mistakes occur at Work or under high-pressure tasks, usually sinking into Self-denial and negative labeling, leading to Decreased efficiency and Performance affected.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once she successfully organized and advanced a large work project; the process went smoothly and she gained the boss's affirmation.
exception_events.reason: Clue: clear task goals, organized, and receiving positive feedback and recognition, reinforcing the sense of competence, thereby reducing Self-denial.

positive_force: Has supportive friends and family, able to provide emotional support
Able to identify thought patterns and actively seek help, Good motivation to change
Has the ability to organize and execute complex tasks (successfully completed large projects)
Already tried self-compassion and self-forgiveness exercises, possessing willingness to improve and preliminary skills
negative_force: Long-term negative self-labeling and a tendency to overgeneralize
Highly sensitive to making mistakes, overly concerned about others' evaluations
Self-criticism as the default reaction, leading to Impaired self-esteem and avoidance
Repeatedly triggered in Work and family situations, forming a vicious cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive self-criticism and negative self-labeling after making mistakes
antecedent: A small mishap occurs in front of others (family/colleague settings)
Small mistakes or setbacks at work
target_behavior.core_reason: The cognitive bias formed in adolescence equating a single mistake with overall incompetence, plus sensitivity to external evaluation and fragile self-esteem
target_behavior.function: Uses preemptive self-blame to evade possible criticism from others and gains a brief sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood, Impaired self-esteem, declining Work efficiency and performance, Strained relationships with family members and tending to Avoids socializing and challenges
